protocol.bootstrap_unit: source_cluster_id within bank/language and actual selected cohort; whole clusters resampled
protocol.pairing: same canonical bank, language and identical article/question keys; intersection only
protocol.context_policy: Never subtract 4K-subset and 8K-full means; report paired intersection with excluded counts
protocol.metrics: Project-local normalization/character-word F1; not official SQuAD/CMRC leaderboard scores
protocol.public_reference_evidence: span-derived proxy, auxiliary only; no genuine reasoning-chain accuracy claim
protocol.aggregation: all planned applicable questions; errors zero; valid subset diagnostic only; missing task N/A
protocol.statistics: exploratory marginal percentile 95% cluster CIs; no tests, p values, multiplicity/winner claims
protocol.small_cluster_policy: fewer than two clusters: CI not estimated; degenerate finite-sample CI is not certainty
protocol.limitations: human review 0; public historical training contamination high/unknown; recent dates do not prove no contamination; provisional clusters; single seed

figure_policy: real audited numeric values only; unavailable pair panels omitted
